exposure: Delivery mode (vaginal delivery, caesarean delivery with medical indications, caesarean delivery on maternal request, urgent cesarean delivery)
outcome: Placental inflammatory response (IL-1β, TNF-a, IL-6, IFN-γ, IL-4, IL-10, IL-8)
cohort: 1978 low-risk women with singleton term births from the Ma'anshan Birth Cohort Study
finding: Maternal placental oxidative stress and inflammatory response were associated with delivery mode, with a more pronounced effect at high levels of expression in women who chose cesarean delivery on maternal request.
mod_finding: Women who chose CD on maternal request had significantly altered expression of IL-1β, IFN-γ, IL-8, and HO-1 at high percentiles compared to vaginal delivery.
